snippet.title: Nos Toca: México | FIFA World Cup 26™ | Episode 14 | Coca-Cola | #TeamBehindTheGame
snippet.description:
Mexico's been living and breathing football for generations. Now it's our turn.

FIFA World Cup 26™ is coming home to Mexico, and Nos Toca digs into what this tournament really means once you step outside the stadiums. From Guadalajara's deep-rooted traditions to Monterrey's modern swagger, from die-hard supporters who've never missed a match to families making brand-new memories together — this episode is all about the passion, pride, and togetherness that football sparks across the country.

Through real stories from Coca-Cola employees, football fans, and communities all over Mexico, see how the FIFA World Cup 26™ brings generations together, pulls communities closer, and creates the kind of moments people talk about for years. As Coca-Cola marks 100 years in Mexico right alongside the country's turn as a FIFA World Cup 26™ host, this is a story about roots, belonging, and passing down a love for the game.

This is #TeamBehindTheGame, a documentary series following the people, places, and stories behind the biggest sporting event on Earth.

snippet.title: Behind the Scenes: How the America250 Anthem & Song Was Made | Drink in America | Coca‑Cola
snippet.description:
To celebrate America's 250th anniversary, Coca-Cola reimagined the iconic 1971 song ""I'd Like to Buy the World a Coke"" by bringing together voices from communities across the United States. This behind-the-scenes look follows the journey of ""I'd Like to Buy America a Coke"", the reimagining of that track and highlights the people who helped bring the project to life.

From road trips and rewrites to recording sessions and shared experiences, the cast and crew represented communities from across America. Together, they demonstrated how different backgrounds, perspectives, and stories can come together to create something meaningful.

As Coca-Cola honors 250 years of America, this project celebrates unity, connection, and the belief that what makes us different can also bring us together.

snippet.title: A Revolution Like No Other: Boston | FIFA World Cup 26™| Episode 13 | Coca-Cola | #TeamBehindTheGame
snippet.description:
As Boston prepares to host the FIFA World Cup 2026™, one of America’s most demanding sports cities faces a new test: can soccer earn a lasting place in New England?

In this episode of Team Behind the Game, discover how Boston’s revolutionary history and culture of innovation are shaping its approach to the tournament. From education and robotics to A.I. and major event planning, Boston has long been a place where new ideas are tested before they spread.

In a city where sports loyalty must be earned, FIFA World Cup 26™ is more than a global event. It is an opportunity to turn curiosity into lasting soccer fandom across Boston and New England.

In this episode:
• Discover how Boston’s revolutionary history continues to shape its future
• Learn how the city’s universities and talent drive innovation
• See why education and long-term planning are central to Boston’s identity
• Go behind the scenes of the FIFA Fan Festival™ in Boston and the Stadium Fan Experience in Foxborough
• See how Coca-Cola is helping deliver the fan experience at scale
• Hear how Boston hopes to build lasting soccer fandom in New England

Subscribe for more episodes of Team Behind the Game and exclusive stories from the FIFA World Cup 26™ Trophy Tour by Coca-Cola.

snippet.title: Welcome to the Mosaic: Canada | FIFA World Cup 26™ | Episode 12 | Coca-Cola | #TeamBehindTheGame
snippet.description:
As Canada prepares to host the FIFA World Cup 2026™, its multicultural communities are showing how soccer has connected generations long before the tournament arrived.

In this episode of Team Behind the Game, discover how Canada’s cultural mosaic has helped shape soccer across the country. As immigrant communities made Canada home, they brought their love of the game with them—turning soccer into a shared language across cultures.

See how Coca-Cola is celebrating Canada’s diverse fans through eight collectible country cans, youth partnerships, and the FC Academy, which introduces young people to careers in sport.

And, as the FIFA World Cup 26™ Trophy Tour by Coca-Cola travels across Canada, fans share what makes Toronto special and why the tournament feels like a celebration of communities that have always called Canada home.

In this episode:
• Discover why Canada is known as a cultural mosaic
• Hear how immigrant communities helped shape soccer culture in Canada
• Learn how Canadians celebrate both their national identity and family heritage
• See how Coca-Cola’s eight collectible country cans represent Canada’s diverse fan communities
• Learn how Coca-Cola, Junior Achievement Canada and The King’s Trust Canada are creating opportunities for young people
• Go inside the FC Academy and explore careers connected to sport
• Follow the FIFA World Cup 26™ Trophy Tour across Canada
• Hear from fans about what they love most about Toronto

Subscribe for more episodes of Team Behind the Game and exclusive stories from the FIFA World Cup 2026™ Trophy Tour by Coca-Cola.

snippet.title: The Team You’re Born Into: Miami | FIFA World Cup 26™ | Episode 10 | Coca-Cola | #TeamBehindTheGame
snippet.description:
In Miami, nobody gets to choose their FIFA World Cup 2026™ team. They're born into it.

In this episode of Team Behind the Game, go inside one of North America’s most vibrant soccer cities, where Miami’s Latin community has kept soccer alive long before it became a national phenomenon. For them, the game goes deeper than sport. It’s in their blood.

From the TV to the streets, Miami fans celebrate everywhere. Hear from fans across Latin America about why they love soccer, what the game means to Hispanic communities, and how Miami’s cultural melting pot makes it a unique host city for FIFA World Cup 2026™.

As Miami prepares to host 7 matches, Coca-Cola is helping bring fans closer to the energy, emotion, and excitement of the world’s biggest sporting event. But for this city, hosting the FIFA World Cup 2026™ was never just about appearing on the global stage.

This one is personal.

In this episode:
•    Learn why soccer is so important to Miami
•    Discover what makes Miami a cultural melting pot for fans from across Latin America
•    Hear how Hispanic fans helped shape soccer culture in Miami
•    See how fans celebrate the game across the city
•    Watch fans react to seeing the FIFA World Cup™ Original Trophy for the first time
•    See how Miami is preparing to welcome everyone for FIFA World Cup 2026™

Subscribe for more episodes of Team Behind the Game and exclusive stories from the FIFA World Cup 2026™ Trophy Tour by Coca-Cola.

The episode captures Seattle’s deep-rooted football culture through emotional fan moments, community celebrations, and immersive Trophy Tour experiences, positioning the city as one of North America’s most passionate and authentic soccer hubs ahead of the 2026 tournament.

From ferry captains crossing Puget Sound to fans sharing memories of past World Cups™, this episode captures the emotion, anticipation, and shared sense of belonging that soccer creates across generations and cultures.

As Seattle prepares to become one of the key host cities for FIFA World Cup 2026™, the city's connection to water, travel, and global community becomes part of the story. The energy surrounding the trophy tour feels like the beginning of something much bigger — a wave of celebration carrying Seattle toward one of the biggest sporting moments in the world.

In this episode:
- Experience the FIFA World Cup 2026™ Trophy Tour arriving in Seattle
- Hear emotional stories from fans and families preparing for the tournament
- Explore Seattle's growing soccer culture and international fan community
- See how the city is preparing to welcome global audiences for FIFA World Cup 2026™

For many fans, the FIFA World Cup™ is more than a tournament — it's memory, identity, family tradition, and shared celebration.

snippet.title: Inside the Engine Room | Coca-Cola FIFA World Cup 2026™ Venue Operations
snippet.description:
The FIFA World Cup 2026™ is one of the largest sporting events on Earth — but behind every match, every FIFA Fan Festival™, and every fan experience is an enormous operational effort few people ever see.

Inside the Engine Room takes us behind the scenes with Coca-Cola’s FIFA World Cup 2026™ venue operations team as they prepare stadiums, concessions, and activations across North America.

From stadium logistics and product distribution to high-pressure matchday preparation, this documentary reveals the hidden teamwork and precision required to help deliver unforgettable FIFA World Cup™ moments for millions of fans.

In this episode:
• Go behind the scenes to see how the venue and stadium operations teams bring the FIFA World Cup 26™ to life
• Learn what happens the day before the match begins
• Get a glimpse of the biggest hurdles the operations team faces and how they work together to make sure every fan has the best experience at the FIFA World Cup 26™

This is the unseen side of the FIFA World Cup 26™ — the people, preparation, and operational excellence behind the game. #TeamBehindTheGame #FIFAWorldCup2026 #VenueOperations #CocaCola

From FIFA Club World Cup 2025™ activations in Times Square to ultras filling the streets with chants and celebration, this episode explores how soccer culture comes alive across New York City and New Jersey. Behind the scenes, Coca-Cola teams, bottlers, operators, and local organizers are preparing for one of the largest sporting events in history.

This is more than match preparation — it's a story about culture, community, and what happens when the world comes together through soccer.

In this episode:

- Experience FIFA Club World Cup 2025™ activations transforming Times Square into a global soccer gathering point
- See how soccer fans from around the world are bringing their cultures and traditions to New York
- Go behind the scenes of Coca-Cola's FIFA World Cup 2026™ operational scaling and preparation

Go behind the scenes with the Coca-Cola team as preparations for FIFA World Cup 26™ take shape in Mexico. From Guadalajara's deep-rooted soccer culture to on-the-ground testing of fan experiences, follow the journey of creating memorable moments for fans before they step into the stadium.

With the countdown underway, teams from across the Coca-Cola business come together to refine every detail—from stadium operations and beverage service to fan engagement and iconic activation spaces. See how ideas are tested, experiences are brought to life, and plans move closer to reality as Coca-Cola prepares to welcome the world to FIFA World Cup 26™.

Discover the collaboration, creativity, and passion driving the fan experience behind one of the world's biggest sporting events.
